_: Item 43 C3 (CR-32). Read by scripts/capture_shots.mjs. One screenshot per large project whose site page IS the project running (a game, a trainer, a live tool), never a page about it. The stage (item 43 C2) shows assets/shots/<slug>.png as the large display. Edit this file, not the script, to change a size, add a project or move a path.
playwright_from_note: Playwright is already installed in that project; the script resolves it from there (createRequire), so no package is added to this repository. A private machine path on purpose: the capture is run by hand on the owner's machine, never in CI.
reduced_motion_note: A still frame: with the flag set every page stops its effects and stays complete (SAFE-05), so two captures of one page agree.
service_workers_note: Gridline shows a banner (No active service worker, offline use is not available) when the worker is blocked, which would put a capture artefact on the large display. A fresh context has no cache and no profile, so allowing it is still a straight read of the files on disk.
settle_note: Wait after the page reports network idle, so a module-built screen has drawn. If a shot ever shows a loading screen, raise this value or the per-project settle_ms.

source.note: Read only. A project is large when its commit count is at or over tiers.large_from, or when its override says large.

gridline.reason: The Gridline map trainer itself, built and served from this folder (a Vite bundle, already built; no build step needed).

cn-conductor-trainer.reason: The Conductor Trainer itself (the CROR study app) running in this folder.

training-assistant.reason: The CROR Training Assistant itself running in this folder.

switch-list.reason: The yard switching trainer itself running in this folder.

not_captured.fulfillment: Its site page (games/fulfillment/) is the generated reference manual, a page about the game; the game itself is a Godot build that runs on itch.io, not on this site. Large display falls back to the medium display unless he supplies an action shot.
not_captured.design-first: Its site page (/method/) is the explainer of the method, a page about the kit; the kit is a Claude Code plugin with no running screen. tools/design-first/ is a redirect. Large display falls back to the medium display; to capture the explainer anyway, add a design-first entry above with path method/.
not_captured.warden: No site page (registry url is null).
not_captured.underwriter: No site page (registry url is null).
not_captured.portfolio-monorepo: The site's own Home; it is not captured into itself.
not_captured.resume: Its page is another repository's site (https://jordan-doerksen.github.io/Resume/), not served from this one.
